question: State the conditions a registered person must satisfy to be entitled to input tax credit under GST.

points.label: Tax invoice
points.description: The recipient holds a tax invoice, debit note or other prescribed tax-paying document.

points.label: Details furnished by supplier
points.description: The supplier has furnished the details of the invoice and they have been communicated to the recipient (appearing in the recipient's statement).

points.label: Receipt of goods or services
points.description: The goods or services have been received (including delivery to another person on the recipient's direction).

points.label: Tax paid and return filed
points.description: The tax charged has actually been paid to the Government by the supplier, and the recipient has furnished its return.

points.label: Payment within 180 days and other rules
points.description: The recipient must pay the supplier within 180 days of the invoice or reverse the credit with interest; for goods received in lots, credit is taken on the last lot; no credit on tax capitalised for depreciation.
